messages:
Zara Ahmed: Hi team — first week here. Quick security question: I tried to register Okta Verify but it errors with 'device not supported' (old Android). My company Mac arrives tomorrow. Can I use SMS for MFA until then? Also I found an old SSH private key in my Dropbox from previous job  I emptied the file but want to know if that's enough.
Liam (People Ops): Welcome Zara :wave: SMS is allowed as a short-term fallback for new joiners but we prefer authenticator apps. We can enable SMS for up to 48h if you open a ticket. Loaner laptop is another option if you need repo access immediately. Please don't store private keys in cloud services.
Cam (Security): Hi and welcome. Short answers: 1) SMS fallback = OK for 48h while you get a managed device or enroll an authenticator; we log the exception. 2) Dropbox-stored private keys = not allowed. Delete the key, empty trash, then rotate any credentials that used that key. If it was ever shared, we need to rotate.
IT-helpdesk: Filed ticket IT-5588 to enable SMS fallback for 48h. If you need immediate repo cloning we can mint a time-limited deploy key scoped to specific repos 24h max. Reply with repo list.
security-bot: Security training assigned: "Security Essentials (Onboarding)" 72h completion window. New joiners exempt from PhishSim for 7 days.
Zara Ahmed: Thanks all. I deleted the file and emptied Dropbox trash. Repo list: redwood/inference-starter and redwood/docs. Can I just attest this in a form or do you need screenshots?
Cam (Security): A short self-attestation + screenshot of the empty folder is fine; attach to the ticket. We'll log the exception. If the key was used on any external machines, rotate and let us know which services.
Liam (People Ops): DMing loaner pickup options and SMS fallback steps now. Welcome aboard :tada: ping us if anything blocks you.
Zara Ahmed: Appreciate it  I'll finish the training tonight and follow up on the ticket.
